templates.why_chosen: Clean 7-component, 4-flow control/data split: an FPGA data plane with four SA Control Threads fans dashed lines into a single control-plane box stacking exactly three named components, avoiding a legend entirely.
templates.what_to_learn: Stack the control plane's three components vertically in one box, label each with its paper section number instead of a legend, and fan dashed lines from every data-plane unit into that shared box rather than drawing one arrow per component.
